text: Lara (Design): putting this here — thinking about the time-range header: if we move presets into the compact header, how should the scrubber behave when the header collapses? screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/latency-header.png Mohit (PM): TL;DR: prefer header collapse for vertical real-estate, but scrubber needs clear affordance to expand. otherwise ppl will think timeline is disabled. :thinking: Sam (Eng): for collapsed header, make scrubber a thin rail with a knob. tap opens full picker. keyboard focus should still jump to the knob. hover can preview a micro-sparkline. Joanne (A11y): agree. keyboard + screenreader support is mandatory. when collapsed, the knob must have aria-label like `Time range: last 30m, press enter to expand`. Also aria-live region for dataset updates when range changes. Lara (Design): note: heatmap density overlays get lost when header condenses — might need an inline micro-legend next to the scrubber in collapsed state. small dot + 3 shade steps. Sam (Eng): implementation idea: keep a tiny canvas 120x24 next to knob that draws a compressed p95 sparkline + density bands. cheap to render. Mohit (PM): cross-team Q: where do sampling controls go? proposals: 1) keep in panel toolbar, 2) move into header overflow, 3) inline under scrubber. pros/cons? Lara (Design): my bias is header overflow to reduce clutter in each panel. but callout should exist when sampling is active — users need to know data is sampled. Joanne (A11y): if moved to header overflow, ensure the sampling toggle isn't hidden from keyboard users. Also any sampled badge must include a tooltip that is accessible (aria-describedby linked to a hidden text node). Sam (Eng): +1. Also API callouts for sampling state: responses should include `x-sampled: 0.01` header so console can surface exact rate. backend already has this header available. Lara (Design): copy question: badge text options: `Sampled (1%)`, `1% sampled`, `Sampling: 1%`. which reads best in tight UI? Mohit (PM): `Sampled (1%)` is concise and matches our other badges like `Cached (10%)`. consistent pattern wins. Joanne (A11y): prefer `Sampling: 1%` from a clarity standpoint for screenreaders — they can parse label+value. but both work if `aria-label` clarifies. Sam (Eng): technical nit: if we do `Sampled (1%)` need to make it clickable to open sampling details. aria role=button. code snippet for role: ```` Sampled (1%) ```` Lara (Design): love that. interaction note: clicking badge should open a compact flyout with `Explain sampling`, `Change rate`, and `Why sample?` microcopy. Mohit (PM): add telemetry event `ui.sampling.badge.click` so we can measure confusion and adoption. DesignBot: auto-check: suggested contrast for badge at background #0f1724 fails WCAG AA at 12px. Recommend white with 14px or increase contrast. Joanne (A11y): flag: when scrubber snap-to-presets is enabled, keyboard users need an option to disable snapping. snapping breaks fine-grained adjustments for keyboard arrow input. propose a `snapping` persisted preference with `prefers-reduced-motion` analog. Sam (Eng): implement as `Ctrl/Meta` modifier to temporarily disable magnetism while dragging; store pref in localStorage. quick patch possible. Lara (Design): microinteraction idea: when user drags knob quickly, show ephemeral label `Live` and throttle metric updates to avoid jank. gives perceived performance. Mohit (PM): UX KPI: reduce accidental range changes by 30% and keep time-to-insight under 2s for 30m ranges. let's aim for that in next sprint. Joanne (A11y): microcopy tweak: change `Live` to `Realtime` for clarity to screenreader users. `Live` is ambiguous. Lara (Design): noted. mock updates: I'll push a compact header variant and a collapsed-scrubber prototype by EOD. Sam (Eng): if you can attach a small prototype URL I'll try hooking keyboard handlers this week. Lara (Design): proto: https://proto.redwood.dev/range-scrubber-collapsed — contains interactive keyboard demo. Mohit (PM): thanks — I'll schedule a 20m usability check with 3 devs tomorrow. DesignBot: test-run summary: keyboard demo passes basic tabindex checks, fails on aria-live timeout. See /qa/issues/199001 for details. Joanne (A11y): I'll triage /qa/issues/199001 and propose specific aria-live phrasing. Lara (Design): super. final ask: please suggest a compact icon for sampling badge (small funnel? wave?). options please in thread. :sparkles:
